terms.definition: The known continent containing the Lumencia Empire, Dominus and the eastern Abyss Zone.
Mana refined inside the body by swordsmen; enhances body and weapons. Becomes visible Sword Aura from Master rank.
A mage's rank, from 1-Circle to 9-Circle. 7-Circle = Archmage (equal to a Master swordsman); 9-Circle = Grand Sage.
Faith-linked holy power distinct from ordinary mana.
Demonic/cursed power associated with Delphirem and the Abyss Zone.
An exceptional mortal conduit of divine power. Aria is the current Saintess.
Ethera, Emily, Carne and Seriel: the four strongest publicly recognized people of the human realm, living legends with immense authority.
The highest-ranking members of the Demon God Cult; each is the vessel of a fragmented aspect of Delphirem (Despair, Void, Desire, Grief).
The second tier of the Demon God Cult, one for each of the seven deadly sins, granted 7-Circle-level power through their pacts.
The leading social circle of the Magic Department, made of high-level students; it organizes galas, balls and ceremonies. President: Elise Reihart; Vice President: Lucia Caldwin.
The main combat and escort circle of the Knight Department, nobles and commoners together: campus security, mock battles and escort missions.
A first-year Theology student from Dominus who dreams of becoming the Holy Maiden. Also spelled Maribel.
The Demon God, sealed in the Abyss Zone, whom the cult seeks to resurrect. Also spelled Delpirem.
Isabel's innate ability. Its exact powers are left to the narrator and revealed gradually.
Title of the single strongest living Master of the Path of the Sword. Only one holder at a time.
Using martial Aura and magic simultaneously at full mastery. Only Emily is known to master it.
Aura made visible as energy, from Master rank onward.
A title of the Holy Kingdom of Dominus, reserved for the most powerful combatant of its Theology.
The lowest rank of the Demon God Cult: minions bound by demonic pacts, some hidden among the academy's students.
Upper, Mid and Lower Priests: the cult's ranks between the Sin Bishops and the Acolytes.
The corrupted far east of Aethermere, prison of Delphirem and source of Miasma and demonic beasts.
The theocracy neighbouring the Empire, worshipping only Lily; capital Lumina.
